title: fix(ui): KPI tiles sit two across on a phone, the calendar footer counts its loaded dates, and record not-found names no access

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgNkgMeS3Ttka5cdjopEKhKg)_

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：手机上首页的 4 个 KPI 卡片改为每行两张；日历视图底部计数改称「为这些日期加载的 N 条记录」；记录打不开时的提示改为「不存在、可能已删除，或你可能没有访问权限」。三处都是界面层改动，十个语言包同步。
- 为什么改：HotCRM 18.2.0 全量走查里，手机首页的四张 KPI 各占一行占满首屏；日历底部的数字其实只是当前日期窗口里的记录，却和列表的「总数」用同一句话；经理打开无权查看的商机时被告知「不存在或已删除」，而服务端对无权读和真不存在都回 404，界面分不出两者。
- 风险与回滚：KPI 改动作用于所有「裸数字 columns 为 4 及以上」的页面网格在手机宽度（sm 以下）的列数，桌面和平板不变，作者写了响应式对象的网格不变；计数只在日历按日期窗口取数时换文案，表格、看板和内联数据的计数原样；文案改动只改两个键的值。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/layout/grid.tsx`（裸数字的手机降级那段）；`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`（record-count-bar 里的 calendarWindowed 分支）；`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts`（新键 `list.calendarRecordCount` 与改值的 `recordNotFoundDescription`）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/components/src/__tests__/grid-phone-tiles-27355.test.tsx packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.calendarFooterCount-27355.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.recordReadFailure-11902.test.tsx`，预期 3 个文件全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Fixes #27355
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

Rows 7, 8 and 11 of #27355, re-measured on `origin/main` at 3f02da10. Rows 1 and 5 are answered in the Acceptance notes and this PR does not touch them.

- **Row 11, KPI tiles on a phone.** A layout `grid` with a bare `columns` count used to ramp to one column below `sm`, so a home page's KPI strip (`columns: 4` over `object-metric` tiles, the same shape as the showcase home and the schema catalog's `report/report-header-with-kpis`) took a row per tile and filled a phone's first screen. A bare count of four or more now draws two across below `sm` and the authored count from `md` (`grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4`). That matches the dashboard's own phone layout, which already puts metric tiles two across (`DashboardRenderer`'s mobile branch). A bare 2 or 3 still stacks on a phone and pairs from `sm`, a bare 1 is one across everywhere, and an authored breakpoint object is drawn as written, `{ xs: 1, md: 4 }` included.
- **Row 11, the page tab strip.** Already done on `main`: `page:tabs` scrolls sideways with an edge fade on the side that hides a tab (`useHorizontalOverflow` + `data-overflow` mask in `containers.tsx`), landed by #27849 after 18.2.0. Measured: the 18.2.0 release commit's `containers.tsx` has no `stripRef`, the #27849 merge has it.
- **Row 8, the calendar's footer count.** A calendar hosted by a list view fetches the date window it draws (`calendarWindowed`), so the footer's `data.length` is that window's records, not the view's. It read `N records`, the words the grid uses for the view's total. It now reads `N records loaded for these dates` (new count family `list.calendarRecordCount`, every CLDR slot in all ten packs, mirrored in `LIST_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS`). Counting the view instead would need a second query without the window; the label is what the existing data path supports. A grid, a board and a calendar over rows handed in whole keep `N records`.
- **Row 7, the record not-found copy.** `getData` reads the record with the caller's context and throws `recordNotFoundError` when the read finds nothing, so a row the reader may not see answers `404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND` exactly like a missing one, and the page cannot tell them apart without the server revealing existence. `empty.recordNotFoundDescription` and `detail.recordNotFoundDescription` now say "The record you are looking for does not exist, may have been deleted, or you may not have access to it." in all ten packs, and `DETAIL_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS` follows. The record page's inline fallback (`RecordDetailView.tsx`) follows too. A refused read (403) still shows the access-denied state, unchanged.
- Changeset: `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/plugin-list`, `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, `@object-ui/i18n` patch.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/components/src/__tests__/grid-phone-tiles-27355.test.tsx`: 4, 5, 6, 8 and 12 across draw two on a phone and the authored count from `md`; controls: 1, 2 and 3 across unchanged, an authored breakpoint object unchanged (three shapes, `{ xs: 1, md: 4 }` among them).
- `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.calendarFooterCount-27355.test.tsx`: a windowed calendar counts the 12 records of its month (not the 42 of the object) as `12 records loaded for these dates`, and one record in the singular; controls: a grid over the same rows reads `42 records`, and a calendar over rows handed in whole reads `42 records`.
- Existing pins updated to the new ramp: `grid-breakpoint-columns-7097`, `grid-flat-columns-retired-11505`, `grid-dom-attribute-whitelist`, schema-catalog `grid-columns-key` (three `columns: 4` examples), and the not-found constant in `RecordDetailView.recordReadFailure-11902` (its 403 and failed-load cases still assert no "may have been deleted").

## Acceptance notes

Per-row disposition of #27355 rows 1, 5, 7, 8 and 11, re-measured on `origin/main` at 3f02da10 (rows 2–4, 6, 9–10 and 12–13 are answered on the card by other seats):

| Row | Bucket | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| 1 · path steps cannot be clicked | CARD (spec, then ui) | `record:path` is a readout by design: its header comment records that it carries no handler and that click-to-advance is a separate feature, and its only channel, the record context, exposes no record-field write. The server side already exists (an update is judged by the object's `state_machine` validation rule, ADR-0020), so the card is a spec opt-in on `RecordPathProps` plus a write channel and confirm in the renderer. Filed by the seat as #28061. |
| 5 · the record page has no Delete | ALREADY DONE (generic path) | The record header's `⋯` menu ends with Delete (`sys_delete` in `RecordDetailView`'s synthesized system actions, present in the 18.2.0 release commit too). It is gated by the same `delete` affordance row (`recordDelete` and `rowDelete` are both `crud: delete, grant: delete` in `affordanceGrants.ts`) and the same per-record verdict as the list row menu, so a reader offered Delete in the list row is offered it in the header. `RecordDetailView.deleteConfirmDialog-11001` passes on this head. If HotCRM can name an object, role and page where the header lacks it, that is a new measurement;  |
| 7 · "does not exist or has been deleted" for an unreadable record | TAKE | This PR (copy names both). |
| 8 · calendar footer counts the loaded window | TAKE | This PR (label names the window). |
| 11 · KPI tiles a row each; tab strip overflows | TAKE (tiles) / ALREADY DONE (tab strip) | This PR for the tiles; the strip by #27849. |

`RecordDetailView.tsx` changes by one line: the inline `defaultValue` of `empty.recordNotFoundDescription` follows the new `en` sentence, which `check-i18n-call-site-keys` (default-value drift) requires. No other line of that file is touched.
